sources.title: The Psychology of Selling and Advertising
How advertising works: What do we really know?

concepts.definition: Attention, interest, desire, action: a sequence that moves a reader from noticing to acting.
Problem, agitate, solution: name a problem, make its cost felt, present the solution.
Models assuming people pass through stages from awareness to action.

questions.q: Where is the ethical limit of the PAS framework?
questions.a: In the agitate step: describing real costs is persuasion, inventing fears is manipulation and may be an aggressive practice.

questions.q: What does a long-form sales page usually end with besides the call to action?
questions.a: A short summary for readers who scroll to the end.

questions.q: Why might the five step formula suit a cold B2B audience better than AIDA?
questions.a: It puts trust and authority first, which unknown sellers need before an offer is taken seriously.
